data.description_suggestion: Replaces the entire watch list for this Enterprise account with a new set of aircraft registrations (maximum 500). This operation is idempotent: calling it multiple times with the same payload produces the same result. Accepts an array of registration marks in the request body. Returns the updated watch list. data.current_description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP. Send initialize, tools/list and tools/call with header Accept: application/json, text/event-stream. Prefer an MCP client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, n8n) over calling this by hand. Guide: https://jettracker.com.br/desenvolvedores
data.summary_suggestion: JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP server for Jet Tracker tools
data.description_suggestion: Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint implementing JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP. Accepts initialize, tools/list, and tools/call requests with Accept header set to application/json or text/event-stream for streaming responses. Provides access to all Jet Tracker tools (aircraft lookup, fleet search, company search, watch management) using the same authentication key as REST endpoints. Stateless and idempotent. Recommended for use with MCP-compatible clients (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, n8n) rather than direct HTTP calls. See https://jettracker.com.br/desenvolvedores for complete tool documentation and examples.
